summaries.1: ISO/IEC 23894:2023 guidance on AI risk management for developers, providers, and users; overlay on ISO 31000.
summaries.2: Context, leadership/governance, stakeholder engagement, and human oversight (educational).
summaries.3: ISO 31000 risk process applied to AI: identify, analyse/evaluate, treat.
summaries.4: Monitoring, records, and re-assessment across the AI life cycle.
summaries.5: Related certifiable ISO/IEC 42001 AIMS; not the EU AI Act.
